AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC with public, application, and database subnets across three AZs, NAT gateways, routes, endpoints, and flow logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-]{1,20}$'
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [6, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [7, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [8, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEipC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-c
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-a
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-b
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-c
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  AppDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  AppDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableA
        - !Ref AppRouteTableB
        - !Ref AppRouteTableC
        - !Ref DbRouteTableA
        - !Ref DbRouteTableB
        - !Ref DbRouteTableC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableA
        - !Ref AppRouteTableB
        - !Ref AppRouteTableC
        - !Ref DbRouteTableA
        - !Ref DbRouteTableB
        - !Ref DbRouteTableC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /vpc/${EnvironmentName}/flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cw
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: AZs used
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Public subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Application subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Database subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  AppRouteTableIds:
    Description: Application route table IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppRouteTableA, !Ref AppRouteTableB, !Ref AppRouteTableC]]
  DbRouteTableIds:
    Description: Database route table IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbRouteTableA, !Ref DbRouteTableB, !Ref DbRouteTableC]]
  NatGatewayIds:
    Description: NAT Gateway IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref NatGatewayA, !Ref NatGatewayB, !Ref NatGatewayC]]

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC with public, application, and database subnets across three AZs, NAT gateways, routes, endpoints, and flow logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\-]{1,20}$'
    Description: Environment name used for tagging resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1827,3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [6, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [7, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      CidrBlock: !Select [8, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 32, 8]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEipC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-c
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-a
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-b
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-c
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-app-rt-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  AppDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  AppDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-a
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-b
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-db-rt-c
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableA
        - !Ref AppRouteTableB
        - !Ref AppRouteTableC
        - !Ref DbRouteTableA
        - !Ref DbRouteTableB
        - !Ref DbRouteTableC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableA
        - !Ref AppRouteTableB
        - !Ref AppRouteTableC
        - !Ref DbRouteTableA
        - !Ref DbRouteTableB
        - !Ref DbRouteTableC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /vpc/${EnvironmentName}/flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cw
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: AZs used
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Public subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Application subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Database subnet IDs (AZ a,b,c)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  AppRouteTableIds:
    Description: Application route table IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref AppRouteTableA, !Ref AppRouteTableB, !Ref AppRouteTableC]]
  DbRouteTableIds:
    Description: Database route table IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref DbRouteTableA, !Ref DbRouteTableB, !Ref DbRouteTableC]]
  NatGatewayIds:
